domains.label: Shared identity and journey entry
domains.weightRationale: Correct identity and pre-draw entry are required before a shared journey can exist.

capabilities.outcome: Create one shared journey bound to the exact active rivalry, two manager profiles and their local Save identities.
capabilities.acceptance: Provider-enforced two-account entry with inactive, wrong-rivalry, wrong-profile and wrong-Save denial.

capabilities.outcome: Reach shared setup from both profiles without first committing two independent local league or club draws.
capabilities.acceptance: Production browser journey from fresh profiles through pairing, ACTIVE and the same empty shared setup.

domains.label: Authoritative shared setup
domains.weightRationale: The highest immediate gap: every later season depends on the same locked league, clubs and season plan.

capabilities.outcome: Both managers see one immutable authoritative League Wheel outcome.
capabilities.acceptance: Production two-account draw convergence plus racing requests, stale base and lost acknowledgement replay.

capabilities.outcome: Both managers receive different permanent clubs from that same committed league.
capabilities.acceptance: Production same-league distinct-club convergence, wrong-league/duplicate denial and no reroll.

capabilities.outcome: Commit one supported 1/3/5/10 season length.
capabilities.acceptance: All supported values and unsupported-value denial; the peer sees the exact committed value.

capabilities.outcome: Each entitled manager confirms the exact setup before shared play starts.
capabilities.acceptance: Production role-isolated confirmation with stale setup rejection and identical final setup on both devices.

domains.label: Season lifecycle and result publication
domains.weightRationale: Repeated two-manager competition needs isolated results and transfer-phase ownership.

capabilities.outcome: Both managers acknowledge starting the matching local FIFA17 careers.
capabilities.acceptance: Role-isolated acknowledgements bind the confirmed clubs and season plan without implying console control.

capabilities.outcome: Preserve the supported transfer challenge and its phase locks across both managers.
capabilities.acceptance: Two-account transfer timer, guesses, signings and completion proof with role ownership and no lost update.

capabilities.outcome: Each manager publishes and reviews supported results for their own exact season.
capabilities.acceptance: Production separate-account submissions, field bounds, wrong-role denial and deliberate review before commit.

capabilities.outcome: Commit one reconciled season only after both reviewed results are ready.
capabilities.acceptance: Production atomic commit with incomplete/duplicate/stale input denied and both manager acknowledgements.

domains.label: Scoring, history and multi-season convergence
domains.weightRationale: The competition must stay correct across every supported season length.

capabilities.outcome: Recompute canonical scores and winner from authoritative supported results.
capabilities.acceptance: All trophy weights, both bonus caps and existing zero-score-only tiebreak rule proven without trusting submitted totals.

capabilities.outcome: Both devices show matching season history, manager records and trophy attribution.
capabilities.acceptance: Production identity-safe history/statistics/trophy projections from the same accepted result revision.

capabilities.outcome: Advance exactly once through every season of 1/3/5/10 plans with fixed clubs.
capabilities.acceptance: Automated complete two-account journeys for all four lengths, no skipped/duplicate season, production progression proof.

domains.label: Shared journey recovery and conflict safety
domains.weightRationale: Existing transport recovery does not yet cover shared setup/results or new mutation ownership.

capabilities.outcome: Recover shared setup and season work after offline, reload, expiry and fresh-session re-entry.
capabilities.acceptance: Stage-specific adverse-network proof preserves the committed journey and never treats an expired session as active.

capabilities.outcome: Reject stale, replay-altered and unauthorized shared journey changes.
capabilities.acceptance: Two-account contention, role/account/device revocation, receipt expiry and quota-failure tests plus provider enforcement.

capabilities.outcome: Preserve exact local Save authority while reconciling shared journey state.
capabilities.acceptance: Read-only Candidate B preview and explicit backup-first Candidate C Apply with exact rollback, unrelated-save immutability and offline fallback.

domains.label: Final reconciliation and terminal closure
domains.weightRationale: Completion is a bounded terminal outcome, not a second transport program.

capabilities.outcome: Reconcile the final season into exactly one completed Showdown on both devices.
capabilities.acceptance: Production final results and history converge with correct winner and no additional season.

capabilities.outcome: Close the completed shared journey terminally without resurrection.
capabilities.acceptance: Production CLOSED remains terminal under delayed publishes, retries, session re-entry and later reads.

domains.label: Physical full journey and stable release
domains.weightRationale: Integrated physical proof earns only the final residual acceptance points.

capabilities.outcome: Complete the integrated journey on two physical devices and independent networks.
capabilities.acceptance: Sanitized Chromebook/Home WiFi plus iPhone/cellular equivalent full shared journey with offline recovery, final reconciliation and terminal closure.

capabilities.outcome: Accept the integrated Shared Showdown Journey as a stable production release.
capabilities.acceptance: Exact deployed runtime complete journey, all mandatory release gates and no open release-blocking journey regression; owner-facing acceptance where required.

creditPolicy.baselinePolicy: One explicit backcast at the verified starting source; existing evidence must satisfy the same full capability criteria. RJR transport completion and local-only gameplay are prerequisites, not automatic SSJR credit.
creditPolicy.regressionPolicy: Append invalidation for the proven failed capability and all currently credited dependents. Preserve old evidence and weights. Recredit requires a new evidence bundle proving the repair.
creditPolicy.modelChangePolicy: SSJR-1.1 is frozen. Changed scope or weights require a new modelVersion with rationale and a separately comparable backcast; never silently rewrite SSJR-1.1.

acceptance100: All fixed capabilities are credited at their required evidence layers, the complete supported two-manager shared journey is production-proven, physical two-device/two-network proof is accepted, no unresolved release blocker remains, and every permanent lock is preserved.

seasonLoop.guard: completedSeason < committedSeasonLength; exactly one increment; clubs immutable

interruptions.resume: Read exact committed journey after reconnect; no speculative authority writes.
Retain original intent/base. Refresh and obtain fresh explicit confirmation; never silently rebase.
Acquire a fresh ACTIVE session for the same entitled rivalry. Resume the existing journey; never recreate or reset it.
Deny protected operations immediately; local-only play stays available.
Fail closed, preserve local state and pending intent; never enable billing.

processMap.terminalPolicy: A terminal journey cannot be recreated by a new session or a delayed write; session closure alone is not full-journey completion.
processMap.fifa17Boundary: FIFA17 matches are played locally; no match-engine streaming, console control or frame synchronization.
